tax: Daň zo stavieb a daň z bytov
statute: Zákon č. 582/2004 Z. z. o miestnych daniach (as amended to 335/2022): tax on buildings and on flats, a rate per m² of built-up or floor area set by the municipality (base rate 0,033 EUR/m², which it may raise or lower; its highest rate at most 10 times its lowest)
dated: Act 582/2004 as applicable 2025; EC Taxes in Europe Database (TEDB), tax 559, situation 01/01/2025 (rest-api/tax/rate and legalBase, harvested 2026-11-21)
unsupported: no capital-city rate declared: Bratislava's 2025 VZN was not reached (rate input localRates.propertyTax)
no absolute range: the 10-times limit is relative to the municipality's own lowest rate, so a rate cannot be checked
the surcharge per further storey (up to 0,33 EUR/m² per storey) and the land tax (0,25 % of the statutory land value): not modelled
local_rate: the municipality's rate is an input: localRates.propertyTax
